patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than Outreach's shape. Choose Outreach only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packa” rather than Demandbase's shape. Workflow advantage: Demandbase leans data-enrichment; Outreach leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging.; Outreach is Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packages; request pricing (seat + AI credits)..
- Workflow coverage skew: Demandbase-leaning data-enrichment vs Outreach-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Outreach — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost; Outreach: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — enterprise quote only.

Poor-fit cases: Demandbase is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices · Outreach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Demandbase if you actually need Outreach's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
